questions.prompt: They have written a story ___ morning. (a since, b for, c and, d with, e at)
steps: Since introduces the starting time.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: That is the pupil ___ mother is sick. (a who, b which, c whose, d whom, e what)
steps: Whose shows possession/relationship.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: I do not think ___ I will go there. (a unless, b if, c although, d and, e to)
steps: Think takes a that-clause here; none of the printed words makes the intended sentence.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.
questions.answer: No correct option. Correct: I do not think that I will go there, or omit that.

questions.prompt: ___ Juma writing a letter? (a are, b will, c were, d wasn't, e am)
steps: Wasn't agrees with singular Juma and takes writing.

questions.prompt: Does Rehema ___ to school daily? (a gone, b going, c goes, d went, e go)

questions.prompt: ___ transmits programmes through radio or television. Bank: momerable, news, broadcasting, advertising, entertain.

questions.prompt: Programmes are meant to ___ and educate people.
steps: Entertain is the base verb coordinated with educate.

questions.prompt: Radio and television create ___ events for viewers.
steps: Memorable means worth remembering.

questions.prompt: Write past: Asha ___ the wall blue (pant, printed).
steps: The source omits i from paint.

questions.answer: Painted is intended if paint is corrected; panted is the past of literal pant but cannot take the wall blue.
